description: Two-seat Nesher T c/n B-04 (ex IAF), received May 1981 and operated as Dagger B by VI Brigada, once carrying President Alfonsín; retired 28 November 2015, assembled by VI Brigada technicians at Viedma airport in August 2018 and installed at the memorial by the lighthouse. Photographed 12 January 2023.
aliases: Nesher T; Dagger T; Mirage 5; c/n B-04
